title: Define live-reload semantics for security settings
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that AdminSettingsService reloads security settings, but MemorySmithRequestGuardMiddleware and the login rate limiter capture IOptions/startup values. Runtime changes to AllowRemoteApi, ApiKey, and rate limits remain stale until restart while the UI reports success. Evidence: MemorySmith.App/Services/MemorySmithRequestGuardMiddleware.cs, Hosting/MemorySmithSecuritySetup.cs, AdminSettingsService.cs, MemorySmithConfigurationSetup.cs. Either use monitor-backed policies or clearly mark settings restart-required and test the contract.
